2506.def:
// GHSA-c8qj-jx8j-fg2w: DotVVM AuthorizeActionFilter does nothing. Fixed in 4.2.11, 4.3.15, 5.0.0-preview09.
DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where SoftwareName has "dotvvm" or SoftwareVendor has "dotvvm"
| extend BaseVer = tostring(split(SoftwareVersion, "-")[0])
| extend PreviewNum = toint(extract(@"preview0*(\d+)", 1, tolower(SoftwareVersion)))
| where (parse_version(BaseVer) < parse_version("4.2.11"))                                              // entire <4.2.11 lineage
     or (parse_version(BaseVer) >= parse_version("4.3.0") and parse_version(BaseVer) < parse_version("4.3.15")) // 4.3.0-preview01 .. 4.3.15
     or (BaseVer == "5.0.0" and isnotnull(PreviewNum) and PreviewNum < 9)                                  // 5.0.0-preview01 .. preview09
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, OSPlatform, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion
| sort by DeviceName asc

id: a1f3c7e2-5b9d-4e21-9c84-7f2e1d6a8b03
status: experimental
description: Detects a forward-proxy request to the NetLicensing REST API whose URL combines the /product/ segment with a traversal/token sequence, the wire artefact of the netlicensing-mcp path-traversal token-redaction bypass (GHSA-hxpf-9xvq-wph8).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hxpf-9xvq-wph8
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_host:
    cs-host|contains:
      - 'go.netlicensing.io'
      - 'netlicensing.labs64.com'
  selection_product:
    c-uri|contains: '/product/'
  selection_traversal:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/token'
      - '/../'
      - '%2e%2e'
      - '%2f'
      - '%5c'
  condition: selection_host and selection_product and selection_traversal
falsepositives:
  - Authorized vulnerability scanning of the NetLicensing integration
level: high
2553.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where Web.dest IN ("go.netlicensing.io","netlicensing.labs64.com") AND Web.url="*/product/*" AND (Web.url="*token*" OR Web.url="*%2e%2e*" OR Web.url="*%2f*" OR Web.url="*%5c*" OR Web.url="*/../*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.http_method Web.url
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| sort - lastTime

2554.sent:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where SyslogMessage has "netlicensing_get_product"
| where SyslogMessage has "ROLE_APIKEY_ADMIN" or (SyslogMessage has "tokenType" and SyslogMessage has "APIKEY") or SyslogMessage contains "/#/tokens/"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcessName, HostName, SyslogMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2554.spl:
index=* "netlicensing_get_product" ("ROLE_APIKEY_ADMIN" OR "tokenType" OR "/#/tokens/")
| table _time host source _raw
| sort - _time

2555.sent:
let lookback = 14d;
let baseline = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(lookback) .. ago(1d))
    | where DestinationHostName has_any ("go.netlicensing.io","netlicensing.labs64.com")
    | where RequestURL contains "/core/v2/rest/token"
    | summarize by SourceIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DestinationHostName has_any ("go.netlicensing.io","netlicensing.labs64.com")
| where RequestURL contains "/core/v2/rest/token"
| join kind=leftanti baseline on SourceIP
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SourceUserName, DestinationHostName, RequestMethod, RequestURL, RequestClientApplication

2555.spl:

| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where firstTime > relative_time(now(), "-1d")
| sort - firstTime

2556.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — USB worm spreads crypto-stealing malware via Windows shortcut files
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("ugate.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("ugate.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2556.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — USB worm spreads crypto-stealing malware via Windows shortcut files ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("ugate.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("ugate.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

id: a3f1c2d4-5b6e-4a7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects explorer.exe launching wscript/cscript/mshta, the execution shape of the crypto-clipper USB worm's document-masquerading LNK files.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/usb-worm-spreads-crypto-stealing-malware-via-windows-shortcut-files/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/06/17/crypto-clipper-uses-tor-worm-like-propagation-for-persistence-control/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1091

  product: windows

    Image|endswith:

      - '\mshta.exe'

falsepositives:

2557.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(*\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE)

2560.def:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
| where FileName endswith ".lnk"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Documents", @"\Desktop", @"\Downloads")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe")
| summarize LnkCount = dcount(FolderPath), Sample = make_set(FolderPath, 10), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where LnkCount >= 5   // worm bulk-replaces documents; benign script-driven .lnk creation is rarely 5+ at once
| order by FirstSeen desc
2560.sent:

| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRename")
| where TargetFileName endswith ".lnk"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Documents", @"\Desktop", @"\Downloads")
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe")
| summarize LnkCount = dcount(TargetFilePath), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated)
    by DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where LnkCount >= 5
| order by FirstSeen desc
2560.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` dc(Filesystem.file_path) as LnkCount min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="created" AND Filesystem.file_name="*.lnk" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Documents\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Desktop\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Downloads\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where LnkCount >= 5 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-94f4-hr76-p5j6
  - https://ostif.org/disclosing-the-badhost-vulnerability-in-starlette/
  - https://badhost.org/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/v1/'
  hostinjection:
    cs-host|re: '[/?#]'
  condition: selection and hostinjection
falsepositives:
  - Authorized web-app pentest / scanner traffic (Burp, Nuclei)
  - Misconfigured client placing a full URL in the Host header
level: high
2740.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.status) as status values(Web.http_method) as http_method values(Web.url) as url from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" by Web.site Web.src Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| regex site="[/?#]"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

2741.sent:
let lookback = 7d;
let failures = ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | where Url has "/v1/"
  | where HttpStatusCode in ("401","403")
  | summarize FailCount=count(), FirstFail=min(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr, HttpHostName;
let successes = ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
  | where Url has "/v1/"
  | where HttpStatusCode in ("200","201")
  | where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderAuthorization)        // succeeded with no key => bypass
  | summarize SuccessCount=count(), FirstSuccess=min(TimeGenerated), LastSuccess=max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr, HttpHostName;
failures
| join kind=inner successes on SrcIpAddr
| where FirstSuccess > FirstFail                          // probe THEN succeed
| where FailCount >= 3                                    // >=3 = deliberate probing, not a single typo
| project SrcIpAddr, ProbedHost=HttpHostName, FailCount, FirstFail, SuccessCount, FirstSuccess, LastSuccess
| order by FirstSuccess desc
2741.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" (Web.status=401 OR Web.status=403 OR Web.status=200 OR Web.status=201) by Web.src Web.site Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| stats min(eval(if(status IN("401","403"),firstTime,null()))) as firstFail max(eval(if(status IN("200","201"),firstTime,null()))) as lastSuccess sum(eval(if(status IN("401","403"),count,0))) as failCount sum(eval(if(status IN("200","201"),count,0))) as successCount by src site
| where isnotnull(firstFail) AND isnotnull(lastSuccess) AND lastSuccess>firstFail AND failCount>=3 AND successCount>0
| convert ctime(firstFail) ctime(lastSuccess)
| sort - lastSuccess

// Article-specific bespoke detection — Pickle in the Middle – Hijacking Vertex AI Model Uploads for Cross-Tenant RCE

// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.

| where (FileName in~ ("gcs_utils.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
